create_chunker_no_chunking: create a NoChunking chunker that returns the original document as-is without splitting
build_text_chunker: build a TextChunker subclass that overrides _chunk_text to split document text into smaller pieces
create_chunk_by_max_tokens: create a ChunkByMaxTokens chunker that splits text into chunks of a specified maximum token count with optional overlap
run_truncate_string_to_max_tokens: run truncate_string_to_max_tokens to return the longest prefix of text within a given token limit
run_filter_by_max_tokens: run filter_by_max_tokens to filter and truncate a stream of texts so total tokens stay within a limit
